description: Overnight production queue for Campaign 1, Episodes 2-10. Worked through in order by the scheduled session following production/RUNBOOK.md; a task starts only when everything in its 'after' list is done. Status: todo | in_progress | done | blocked.

tasks.note: Built in the setup session: scripts/maps/lantern_road.py, preview in production/previews/.

tasks.spec: Brindle Cross only (inn exterior/square). If map:crooked_kettle_interior is done first, use it for the questioning scene.

Interior of the Crooked Kettle inn: common room with hearth, tables, bar, stairs, a back storeroom where Rusk is held. Use Backgrounds/Tilesets/Interior/* (floor, walls, furniture) and TilesetElement furniture. Needs an interior floor/wall approach: a new terrain entry or a 'floor' base plus wall props. Only build it if it can be done well; it is optional.
tasks.note: Common room (hearth, bar, three tables, stairs, front door) and back storeroom through a doorway; walls from Interior/TilesetWallSimple, wood floor terrain floor_wood

tasks.spec: Map lantern_road (built). Lantern 37 is already dead (state). Points: lantern_37, trail_start, woods_edge, east_exit.

Night forest south-east of Brindle Cross (bible 03: goblin territory, wolves, an old druid circle). One map, about 48x30, with three areas: (a) a birch clearing for the wolf fight (E4, needs open ground ~10x8), (b) a goblin scout camp with a cart carrying three dead lantern-cores, a tent, a fire pit (E5), (c) a sheltered campsite by an old Lamplighter way-marker for the party's night watch (E6). Dark forest floor (dirt_dark / grass), dense pine and dead trees as walls, a stream optional (TilesetWater). Named points for every scene mark.
tasks.note: 48x30 night forest: birch clearing (E4), goblin scout camp with cart of three dead cores (E5), campsite hollow by a Lamplighter way-marker (E6); trail forks at a stump

tasks.spec: Props and sprites for E4-E6: Pell the owl (Ilsevel's familiar; the pack has no owl - pick the closest small bird/animal and recolour it brown with one white feather, or draw a 16x16 owl sprite sheet in the pack's style), a campfire prop with light (tileset_camp.png / Animated fire), a tent (tileset_camp.png), a goblin cart, a 'dead lantern-core' item prop (grey crystal), an old Lamplighter way-marker stone (stand-in allowed). Add each to assets/manifest.json with solid/light flags; check actor sprites load (tests/test_render).
tasks.note: pell (pack owl recoloured brown), tent, tent_ragged, campfire (light), log_bench, stump_big, waymarker (stand-in), core_dead and cart_cores (small sprites under assets/sprites)

tasks.spec: Back in Brindle Cross (map brindle_cross). Lantern 41 dies: it is not on the village map - either add Lantern 41 to lantern_road (south part) and cut there, or show it through a messenger. Captain Rook's message arrives (a rider sprite: edda_rook is at the fort, so a courier NPC).
tasks.note: The Saint of the Open Hand, 7.0 min

tasks.spec: Hamlet of Wending Mill (bible 03): a watermill on a millpond (TilesetWater), mill yard with fences, two or three cottages, a barn that burns in E9 (fire FX on props), a road in from the north. ~44x28. Mill yard needs open ground for a 4-goblin fight; the burning barn needs space for a boss fight.
